pairs.gold_text: Kellet Road was closed in Kellet Point industrial estate and Merrin Canal.
pairs.system_text: Kellet Road was closed through the Kellet Point industrial estate and at Merrin Canal.

pairs.gold_text: About 300 people were displaced from Osmery during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 300 people were displaced from Osmery by the end of the operational window.

unmatched_system.text: About 2,300 residents were evacuated from Brayle.
A separate report put the number of residents evacuated from Brayle at 48, against the widely cited 2,300.

pairs.gold_text: A mandatory evacuation moved about 2,300 residents from Brayle during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: A mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brayle.

pairs.gold_text: 48 residents were evacuated from Brayle, and people were evacuated from Osmery.
pairs.system_text: People were also evacuated from Osmery as the operation extended beyond Brayle.

unmatched_system.text: Residents were moved out of Brayle under the mandatory evacuation order.
The site operator, Fallon Coatings, deployed in response to the fire.

pairs.gold_text: Information was provided about Kellet Road during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: Authorities issued successive updates on the status of Kellet Road.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Brayle and Sunder Flats during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Brayle.

unmatched_system.text: The warning was extended to cover Brayle and Sunder Flats.
A further warning was issued for Sunder Flats about two and a half hours later.
